regions.today: A cloudy evening with isolated showers and moderate westerly winds. Outbreaks of rain and drizzle will spread from the west later.
regions.tonight: Cloudy at first tonight with patchy outbreaks of rain and drizzle. The rain and drizzle will clear eastwards during the night, with isolated showers following. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees in light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Wednesday, will be mostly dry to start, but frequent showers will spread from the west during the morning. Some of the showers will be heavy with the chance of isolated thunderstorms. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees in moderate, occasionally fresh, west to southwesterly winds.
